results.title: Zebras
results.overview: A young man lends his house to a friend while he is away at work, leading the friend to embark on a schizophrenic adventure.

results.title: The Mirror
results.overview: Young filmmaker Juan invites Mateo, a former actor who abandoned his artistic ambitions, to star in a short film about two men confronting a forbidden attraction. As rehearsals deepen, the story begins to feel less and less like fiction. Juan and Mateo begin unconsciously mirroring the very relationship they are creating for the screen. Glances linger, boundaries blur and the creative process exposes fears, frustrations and desires neither man is prepared to confront.

results.title: Palimpsest 3: Bell Riots
results.overview: A series of 1 reel diary films made up of improvised superimpositions. The mundane and the absurd aspects of contemporary life that overwrite one another: the moon over Seattle, the trees turning red along with Michigan, the Cardassian occupation of Bajor, children burning in their tents, revolt in the Sanctuary Districts. Captured in camera without editing on 8mm and blown up to 16mm.

results.title: Helena con H
results.overview: Helena is on the verge of losing her home because her name was deliberately misspelled in her late husband’s will. Together with her son, Armando, she attempts to rectify this injustice by confronting a bureaucratic, corrupt, and patriarchal system—a process that brings them closer as mother and son.

results.title: Remembrance
results.overview: A young woman, Grace, escapes captivity and wakes with no memory. Detectives attempt to piece together who she is and why she was targeted, but get far more than they bargained for while searching for answers as Grace starts to relive memories without knowing if they're real or imagined.

results.title: This is Not a Heartbeat
results.overview: Interrogates how science is translated, mythologized, and weaponized through the story of one misunderstood sound: the fetal heartbeat. At six weeks, the so-called ‘heartbeat’ is not the sound of a heart at all, but machine-generated audio. Yet this manufactured signal has become deeply emotional and politically charged, used to restrict abortion access across the U.S.

results.title: Outposts: Nothing Here is Yours
results.overview: Outposts have become a major tool for taking control of land in the occupied West Bank and displacing Palestinian communities. These communities face escalating daily violence, threats and when they simply can’t take it anymore – displacement. Over 60 Palestinian communities have been displaced since October 7. Israeli activists come in daily shifts, armed only with their phones, to document, confront settlers, and stand in solidarity as the Palestinian communities struggle to remain on their land.

results.title: One Eye Open
results.overview: A recent college graduate house-sitting for her ailing grandfather finds herself caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with thieves who become haunted by something supernatural protecting her in the mysterious mansion.

results.title: Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2
results.overview: An aging political comrade leaves his career behind for marriage, only to find himself trapped in a chaotic, comical bind between two women and the bitter grudges of opposing political families.

results.title: Seriously Single Too
results.overview: Dineo and Noni — besties meant to take on the party scene together — suddenly face their biggest fear when Noni's boyfriend spontaneously propose.

results.title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
results.overview: Hyper organized single mom and party planner Lexi, her free-spirited mother June, and teen daughter Piper are set to spend Christmas at a local ski resort after Lexi is hired to organize their annual holiday party. Upon arrival, she immediately butts heads with Ridge, the ski instructor and son of the lodge's owner, Dan.

results.title: Kashpirovsky. Under the Spell
results.overview: The film tells the remarkable story of Dr Anatoly Kashpirovsky, who, at the height of his career, claimed to anaesthetise three women remotely for major surgery through the sheer force of his persuasion. His televised healing séances, broadcast across the Soviet bloc, broke viewing records, reaching hundreds of millions of people. Loved by his followers and despised by his enemies, Kashpirovsky became an unlikely symbol of a world undergoing radical political transformation.

results.title: Kate Berlant: Parmesan
results.overview: Seamlessly weaving through personal stories and stream-of-consciousness epiphanies, Kate Berlant offers up reflections on everything from the moon, to her destructive relationship to technology, to the evolving nature of sexuality.

results.title: White Belt
results.overview: Set in present-day Los Angeles, this Dramedy follows Rick Dale as he pursues his passion of becoming a writer. When a new student Tay comes in and upsets the balance of the predominately male Jiu Jitsu gym, Rick does everything in his power to try and scare her away. In the end, his hand is forced when he realizes she is an esteemed author he happens to love. In exchange for training, Rick bargains for Tay's tutelage and expertise in the world of prose. Tay makes Rick ultimately realize that he is irrevocably bad at writing and has been shucking his true calling and responsibility of being the Jiu Jitsu champion that he is.

results.title: Nature
results.overview: Eight longtime friends head deep into the wilderness for an annual camping trip, hoping for a weekend away from the pressures of everyday life. But when a masked stranger emerges from the woods and brutally murders one of them, their getaway becomes a fight for survival. Trapped and surrounded by a mysterious group known as The Eyes, the remaining campers are given an impossible choice: identify a supposed traitor among them...or sacrifice one of their own each night. With no way out and trust becoming a liability, the group must decide how far they are willing to go to survive.

results.title: Alchemy in Venice
results.overview: In the eclectic world of Venice Beach, three artists searching for purpose find their lives unexpectedly intertwined.
